about.title: What is dm<sup>2</sup> — a Real Estate Investment Platform
about.paragraph-1: dm<sup>2</sup> is a real estate investment model that allows you to invest in small fractions of property — square decimeters — instead of purchasing an entire property.
about.paragraph-2: This approach makes real estate investing accessible beyond large institutional investors. With as little as €150, you can participate in profitable real estate development projects and earn passive income from property sales.
about.paragraph-3: The concept of fractional real estate investing is already well established in developed markets such as the <prypco>United Arab Emirates</prypco>, <parcl>the United States</parcl>, and <japan>Japan</japan>, where thousands of individual investors use it to invest smartly while managing risk. Through the dm<sup>2</sup> platform, this model is now available to anyone.
about.paragraph-4: Investments are made at the earliest, project-planning stage, when entry prices are the lowest. Once construction is completed, the properties are sold to end buyers, and the resulting profit is distributed among project investors, DM² token holders, and the core team responsible for execution.
about.h2: Two ways you can invest with dm²
about.section-1-title: Direct investment in real estate projects
about.section-1-p-1: Through the dm<sup>2</sup> platform, investors can allocate capital directly into real estate development projects, including residential and mixed-use complexes, hotels, office buildings, business centers, and other property types — starting from the earliest development stage.
about.section-1-p-2: The minimum investment corresponds to the price of one-tenth of a square meter under construction, or 10 square decimeters. Investors may choose to invest in multiple square decimeters or full square meters, up to one or multiple complete properties.
about.section-2-p-1: Investing in DM2 digital tokens allows investors to make a single investment and receive a share of profits from all successfully completed projects, as long as the tokens remain in their ownership.
about.section-2-p-2: This investment model represents a long-term passive income strategy. In addition, DM2 tokens provide their holders with exclusive benefits, including:
about.section-2-point-1: Exclusive real estate investment opportunities available only to token holders
about.section-2-point-2: Preferential pricing when making direct property investments through square decimeters
about.section-2-point-3: The ability to sell tokens at any time, at the same or a higher price than the purchase price

how-it-works.title: How the dm<sup>2</sup> real estate investment platform works
how-it-works.description-p-1: The dm<sup>2</sup> concept is simple: instead of a single large investor financing an entire project, multiple smaller investors jointly invest in real estate development.
how-it-works.description-p-2: Together, they provide funding during the planning and construction phases, and once the property is sold, profits are transparently distributed among project investors, DM2 token holders, and the team managing execution.
how-it-works.we-take-care-card-1-text: Our team of experts identifies attractive locations for developing various types of real estate and high-potential investment opportunities.
how-it-works.we-take-care-card-2-text: We conduct legal, ownership, urban planning, and financial analyses and develop the project from start to finish.
how-it-works.we-take-care-card-3-text: We negotiate and purchase land parcels intended for development and secure all necessary construction permits.
how-it-works.we-take-care-card-4-text: We tokenize each project and give investors the opportunity to invest in a specific property by purchasing square decimeters.
how-it-works.we-take-care-card-5-text: We manage the sale of properties to end buyers at market prices, ensuring the highest possible profit.
how-it-works.we-take-care-card-6-text: We distribute profits from property sales to investors and DM2 token holders in a transparent and real-time manner.
how-it-works.process-title: What the entire process looks like
how-it-works.process-card-1-text: Every project starts with an idea. At this stage, a proposal is prepared and published on the dm<sup>2</sup> platform to be presented to potential investors.
how-it-works.process-card-2-text: Investors have the opportunity to invest directly in the project at the initial, most favorable price per square meter by purchasing square decimeters.
how-it-works.process-card-3-text: Once the minimum required funding is secured, construction begins in accordance with the project plan.
how-it-works.process-card-4-text: Property sales to end buyers at market prices begin already during the construction phase.
how-it-works.process-card-5-text: Revenue from sales is distributed among project investors, DM2 token holders, and the execution team, fully transparently and in real time.
how-it-works.profit-sharing-paragraph-1: To clearly illustrate how returns work, here is a simple example:
how-it-works.profit-sharing-paragraph-2: Imagine a residential building with a total area of 10,000 m<sup>2</sup>. The construction price is €1,500 per square meter, while the sale price is €2,500 per square meter.
how-it-works.profit-sharing-paragraph-3: This means that a profit of €1,000 is generated per square meter, which is shared as follows:
how-it-works.profit-sharing-paragraph-4: €600 goes to project investors (40% of the profit)
how-it-works.profit-sharing-paragraph-6: €200 goes to the project execution team (project developer)
how-it-works.profit-sharing-paragraph-7: Project investors recover their initial investment of €1,500 plus an additional €600 in returns, meaning they receive a total of €2,100 per square meter, representing a 40% profit relative to their investment.
how-it-works.profit-sharing-table-2-title: Profit per square meter is then shared

token.title: What is the DM2 token and what is it used for
token.disclaimer: Digital tokens are fully regulated under the Law on Digital Assets, and we are currently in the process of submitting the White Paper to the Securities Commission of the Republic of Serbia for evaluation and approval. This approval ensures compliance, transparency, and investor protection.
token.paragraph-1: On the dm<sup>2</sup> platform, there are two ways to invest:
token.paragraph-5: By investing in units, you invest in a single specific project and generate a one-time profit once the project is completed and sold.
token.paragraph-6: By investing in DM2 tokens, you gain the right to a share of profits from all future projects executed through the dm<sup>2</sup> platform — long-term and passively, for as long as you hold the tokens.
token.paragraph-7: Digital tokens are not new to our market — we already have successful examples through projects such as <finspot>Finspot</finspot>, <treesury>Treesury</treesury>, <walnut>Walnut Fund</walnut>, and others.
token.paragraph-9: Passive income: earn from all successfully completed projects
token.paragraph-10: Lower risk: the minimum token price is guaranteed by the dm2 platform
token.paragraph-11: Liquidity: tokens can be sold at any time, at the same or a higher price
token.paragraph-12: Transparency: track all data related to earnings, tokens, and sales through your dm2 account
token.paragraph-13: Join the waitlist and be among the first to purchase DM2 tokens under the most favorable conditions.

Privacy-policy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy-policy.description: Privacy Policy for the dm<sup>2</sup> platform.
Privacy-policy.paragraph-2: On the dm² (Decimetar Kvadratni) website (“dm²”, “we”, “us” or “our”), available at https://decimetarkvadratni.com, your privacy is very important to us. This Privacy Policy explains when, why, and how we collect, use, store, and protect your personal data when you use our website and services related to our real estate investment model through smaller units (“square decimeters”).
Privacy-policy.paragraph-3: By using our services, you accept the practices described in this Privacy Policy.
Privacy-policy.paragraph-4: When, why, and how we collect data
Privacy-policy.paragraph-5: In order to successfully provide our services (including order processing and potential investment flows), we need to collect, process, and store certain personal data, and in limited cases share it with contractually engaged service providers.
Privacy-policy.paragraph-6: Data collected during registration / account creation
Privacy-policy.paragraph-7: If you create an account, we may collect:
Privacy-policy.paragraph-8: For individuals: first and last name, address (city, country, postal code), email address, phone number (optional), personal document data (type and number), citizenship (if legally required).
Privacy-policy.paragraph-9: For legal entities: business details and representative details (name, email, phone), and potentially personal document data and citizenship.
Privacy-policy.paragraph-11: Purpose: account creation, authentication, and enabling access to services.
Privacy-policy.paragraph-12: Legal basis: taking steps at your request prior to entering into a contract and/or performance of a contract, as well as our legitimate interest in ensuring secure access.
Privacy-policy.paragraph-14: When you make a purchase or order, we collect:
Privacy-policy.paragraph-15: Payment data: processed by our payment processor; dm² does not store card numbers.
Privacy-policy.paragraph-16: Transaction details: amount, currency, status, time, payment method, (if blockchain is used) wallet address.
Privacy-policy.paragraph-17: Purpose: order processing, payment, invoicing, customer support.
Privacy-policy.paragraph-18: Legal basis: performance of a contract and compliance with legal/financial regulations.
Privacy-policy.paragraph-20: If you subscribe, we may send you news, newsletters, and offers.
Privacy-policy.paragraph-21: Data: name, email, phone (optional), information about interests.
Privacy-policy.paragraph-22: Legal basis: your consent (which can be withdrawn at any time via the “unsubscribe” option or by sending an email to info@decimetarkvadratni.com).
Privacy-policy.paragraph-24: If you contact us (e.g. via a contact form), we process your name, email, and the content of your message.
Privacy-policy.paragraph-25: Purpose: responding to inquiries and providing support.
Privacy-policy.paragraph-26: Legal basis: our legitimate interest in communicating with users and interested parties.
Privacy-policy.paragraph-28: We do not sell, rent, or share your data with third parties for marketing purposes.
Privacy-policy.paragraph-29: Data may be made available exclusively to contractual data processors (e.g. hosting providers, technical support providers, payment processors), and only to a strictly limited extent.
Privacy-policy.paragraph-31: Our primary infrastructure is located in the USA and the EU.
Privacy-policy.paragraph-32: Some providers may process data from other countries (e.g. EU, USA), with appropriate safeguards applied (Standard Contractual Clauses or equivalent).
Privacy-policy.paragraph-33: If blockchain transactions are used, certain data may be permanently recorded on decentralized networks accessible globally.
Privacy-policy.paragraph-35: Data related to contracts/orders: retained until the expiration of statutory limitation periods and mandatory retention periods under accounting, tax, and AML regulations.
Privacy-policy.paragraph-36: Data processed based on legitimate interest (e.g. inquiries): retained until the purpose is fulfilled; typically up to 3 years.
Privacy-policy.paragraph-37: Data based on consent (e.g. marketing): deleted upon withdrawal of consent.
Privacy-policy.paragraph-39: Our services are intended exclusively for adults (18+). We do not knowingly collect data from children. If you believe a child has provided us with data, please contact us at info@decimetarkvadratni.com for deletion.
Privacy-policy.paragraph-41: We apply appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect personal data from unauthorized access, loss, or misuse. However, no method of transmission or storage is completely risk-free.
Privacy-policy.paragraph-43: In accordance with the Personal Data Protection Law of the Republic of Serbia, you have the right to:

Privacy-policy.paragraph-45: Rectification of inaccurate or incomplete data.
Privacy-policy.paragraph-48: Data portability in a machine-readable format.
Privacy-policy.paragraph-49: Object to processing based on legitimate interest.
Privacy-policy.paragraph-50: Withdraw consent when processing is based on consent.
Privacy-policy.paragraph-51: To exercise your rights, contact us at info@decimetarkvadratni.com.
Privacy-policy.paragraph-52: You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the competent authority:
Privacy-policy.paragraph-53: Commissioner for Information of Public Importance and Personal Data Protection
